column1: # daemon/data/manual_places.tsv
# Hand-curated overlay for daemon/geocoding.py's gazetteer, loaded on top of
# the GeoNames-derived data/cl_gazetteer.tsv.gz. Kept in a separate file --
# not folded into build_gazetteer.py's output -- for two reasons:
#   1. Re-running build_gazetteer.py against a fresh GeoNames export must
#      never silently drop these rows. GeoNames classifies mines as feature
#      class S (facility), which build_gazetteer.py's whitelist deliberately
#      excludes wholesale: the Chile extract has ~1,800 mine entries, many
#      sharing generic Spanish names ("Alicia", "California", "Blanca")
#      that would introduce fresh ambiguous matches for every real locality
#      sharing that name. This file names the specific mines CSN actually
#      cites in RefGeografica, not a reopening of that whitelist.
#   2. Several of these mines -- El Teniente, Radomiro Tomic, Spence,
#      Ministro Hales, Los Pelambres, Andina, Candelaria, Zaldívar,
#      Centinela, Gabriela Mistral -- aren't in GeoNames' Chile extract
#      under any feature class at all. Their coordinates below are the
#      mine site's approximate public location (general geographic
#      knowledge), not sourced from GeoNames -- verify against an
#      authoritative source before trusting them at sub-km precision.
#      Collahuasi, Chuquicamata, Escondida and El Salvador *are* in
#      GeoNames (just excluded by the class-S whitelist) and use those
#      coordinates directly.
# When a future CSN RefGeografica fails to geocode because it names a mine
# (see geocoding.py's DEBUG "reason=not_found" logs), add it here as one
# row -- this is the file to extend, not build_gazetteer.py's whitelist.
# Columns match data/cl_gazetteer.tsv.gz: name, asciiname, lat, lon, fclass,
# fcode, admin1, population. fclass=S/fcode=MN (GeoNames' "mine(s)" code)
# throughout, so these rank behind any populated place sharing the same
# name in geocoding.py's ambiguity resolution (see _CLASS_RANK) -- a town
# should win over a mine of the same name. admin1 is left blank: it's
# parsed but never used by geocoding.py (see Gazetteer.load), and we'd
# rather leave it empty than assert a GeoNames admin1 code we haven't
# verified.
name
Collahuasi
Chuquicamata
Escondida
El Teniente
Radomiro Tomic
Spence
Ministro Hales
Los Pelambres
Andina
